high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures a woman walking away from the camera on a wooden deck surrounded by lush greenery. The setting appears to be an outdoor garden or patio area, with various plants and shrubs visible in the background. The woman is wearing a form-fitting, elegant dress with a low back and a flowing skirt that extends to her ankles. Her hair is styled in loose waves, cascading down her back. The deck is made of wooden planks, and there is a stone wall to the left side of the image, partially covered with ivy.
